statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-15 on the v0.107.80 source. The advisory (GHSA-mwwc-3jv2-62j3) ranges from 0.95 to 0.108.0-b.16, a pre-release of the 0.108 beta line, so every 0.107.x release falls inside it by version order alone. The fix (commit 756b14a, 'imp cookie security; rm plain-text apis') shipped on the 0.107 line in v0.107.14 (2022-09-29): CHANGELOG.md:2532-2538 names CVE-2022-32175 under v0.107.14 Security. In v0.107.80 every POST, PUT and DELETE on the control API goes through ensureContentType (internal/home/control.go:275-277, defined at :293), which rejects form-style requests and bodiless requests that carry a Content-Type, so a cross-site form cannot change the filtering rules; the session cookie is SameSite=Lax (internal/home/authhttp.go:241, :281); the plain-text filtering API the CSRF used is removed. Revisit if the advisory range is corrected or a new CSRF advisory names the 0.107 line.
